hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Cosao, a newly discovered language on the border of Laos and China,
is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:ld:BaiXu:Cosao**). It is probably in the Bi-Ka subgroup of Sino-Tibetan but mutually unintelligible with any of them. I wish to thank Andrew Hsiu for bringing this language and the work of **hh:ld:BaiXu:Cosao** to my attention.
